deepseek-v4-1-flash-uncensored.reason: dealignai's DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Uncensored, an abliterated build of DeepSeek's V4.1-Flash base with refusals removed in the weights (per VeniceStats and vendor listings); a weight-edited derivative is not the DeepSeek base model.

gemma-4-uncensored.reason: Venice's Gemma 4 Uncensored is a community-style derivative of Google's Gemma 4 26B A4B Instruct with the internal refusal direction dampened in activation space (per VeniceStats); a weight-edited derivative is not google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it itself.

openai-gpt-61-sol-ultrafast.reason: Venice's own listing states GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast is OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol model; Ultrafast is a service tier (about 6x standard pricing) of the same checkpoint, so it is still openai/gpt-6.1-sol.
